description: CLI commands for tunnel management operations

requirements.title: Status command shows tunnel health
requirements.description: tunnel-manager status displays: systemd status, /ready status, HA connections, error rate, management mode (local/remote), last recovery event

requirements.title: Health field display
requirements.description: Display systemd status, /ready status, HA connections count, and error rate in a formatted table

requirements.title: Management mode badge
requirements.description: Show current management mode (local/remote) and last recovery event in status output

requirements.title: API health endpoint consumption
requirements.description: Status command fetches health data from the tunnel-manager API endpoint

requirements.title: Status supports JSON output
requirements.description: --json flag outputs machine-readable health summary for scripting and agent consumption

requirements.title: Routes command lists all published routes
requirements.description: tunnel-manager routes displays a table: subdomain, scenario, expected port, status (up/down/degraded), last probe time

requirements.title: Route table formatting
requirements.description: Format route data as an aligned table with columns for subdomain, scenario, port, status, and timestamp

requirements.title: Status color coding
requirements.description: Color-code route status (green=up, yellow=degraded, red=down) in terminal output

requirements.title: Routes command supports JSON output
requirements.description: --json flag outputs machine-readable route list for scripting and agent consumption

requirements.title: Probe command runs all probes
requirements.description: tunnel-manager probe runs internal + external probes on all enabled routes and displays results with classification (up, tunnel-issue, scenario-down)

requirements.title: Probe command supports JSON output
requirements.description: --json flag outputs machine-readable probe results for scripting and agent consumption

requirements.title: Audit command checks port compliance
requirements.description: tunnel-manager audit scans all manifested scenarios and reports: compliant, non-compliant (with expected vs actual), missing. Exit code 1 if any violations found.

requirements.title: Non-zero exit on violations
requirements.description: Return exit code 1 when any port compliance violations are found for scripting integration

requirements.title: Audit command supports JSON output
requirements.description: --json flag outputs machine-readable audit results with violation counts for scripting and agent consumption
